blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' October 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.
Surrey houses with acreage sold, November 2025 to October 2026

18 houses with acreage sold in Surrey with a median price of $2,675,000 (the middle half sold between $2,182,500 and $3,385,000), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 91.3% of the last list price; 11% sold above list. They had a median year built of 1976 and a median lot of 1.02 acres.

blocks.source: Source: Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, MLS® Home Price Index, October 2026 (released November 3, 2026). The benchmark is the board’s modelled price for a typical home of this type, not an average of sales. The index sets January 2005 at 100. Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: Surrey: the detached houses benchmark was $1,288,000 in October 2026. Over the past year it fell 8.9%; over three months it fell 2.8%; over the last month it was little changed (-1.2%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 17.2%; over 5 years it fell 11.6%. North Surrey: the detached houses benchmark was $1,254,500 in October 2026. Over the past year it fell 9.8%; over three months it was little changed (-0.8%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move); over the last month it was little changed (+0.2%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 15.0%; over 5 years it fell 11.9%.

In dollars, the Surrey detached benchmark tells the same story as the percentages: in the Surrey board area it stood near $1,374,600 six months ago and near $1,555,600 three years ago, which puts today's $1,288,000 about $86,600 below the first mark and $267,600 below the second; in North Surrey it stood near $1,310,900 six months ago and near $1,475,900 three years ago, which puts today's $1,254,500 about $56,400 below the first mark and $221,400 below the second. An acreage usually sells for more than the benchmark house, so treat these as a guide to direction rather than a price.
Detached houses against other home types in Surrey

Surrey: the detached houses benchmark of $1,288,000 sits $543,700 above the townhomes benchmark of $744,300 (173% of it) and $834,400 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $453,600 (284% of it). North Surrey: the detached houses benchmark of $1,254,500 sits $583,500 above the townhomes benchmark of $671,000 (187% of it) and $862,200 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $392,300 (320% of it).

faq.q: What did acreages in Surrey sell for?
faq.a: 18 houses with acreage sold in Surrey between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $2,675,000.

faq.q: How long do acreages take to sell in Surrey?
faq.a: The median was 22 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 91.3% of the last list price (11% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most acreages in Surrey sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 18 houses with acreage that sold in Surrey went for between $2,182,500 and $3,385,000, around a median of $2,675,000.

faq.q: Do acreages in Surrey sell above asking price?
faq.a: 11% of the 18 houses with acreage sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 91.3% of it.

faq.q: How old are the acreages that sold in Surrey?
faq.a: The median year built was 1976 for the 18 houses with acreage sold in Surrey.

faq.q: Is Surrey a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026 houses in Surrey had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many acreages are for sale in Surrey?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the acreages in Surrey that match what you want.
